meta_description_en: Editorial for Outlet #101: acute shortage of 3" disks for the ZX Spectrum +3, switching to Plus D interface, and news on the arrest of former Spectrum coder Chris Pile.
meta_description_ru: Редакторская колонка Outlet #101: дефицит 3" дискет для ZX Spectrum +3, альтернатива в виде Plus D и новость об аресте спектрумовского автора Криса Пайла (Chris Pile).
body_en_plain:
J A N U A R Y,  1 9 9 6

There is a useful little program
to repair certain types of BASIC
corruption in this issue. We've
not seen such a thing before yet
already a more advanced fixer is
on its way so watch out for that
in a future issue!

Regular readers will remember
that early in 1994 there was a
severe shortage of 3" disks for
the Plus 3 version of OUTLET.
After a lot of chasing around we
finally tracked down a couple of
sources of "re-cycled" disks of
unsold commercial software and
this has carried us through the
last 12 months.

These stocks have now come to an
end and, after several telephone
calls, we were looking at the
unthinkable task of announcing
the forthcoming end of the Plus
3 version of OUTLET in this very
editorial! However, at the elev-
enth hour, an advert torn from a
magazine many months ago flutt-
ered from a file and provided a
reprieve.

A telephone call confirmed that
stocks were available and our
flexible friend took a thrashing
as we decided to order 6 months
stock.

As these words are being written
the stock has only just been
delivered so we do not yet know
what quality these disks are
but, hopefully, they will be at
least as good as our dwindling
present stocks.  These tend to
have a 10% failure rate at the
format stage with the odd disk
being returned from readers
after despatch.Part of the prob-
lem here is the fact that we
need to format them to 203K each
side in order to cram on all the
OUTLET goodies in every issue.


The original hope that Amstrad's
factory in Italy would take up
production has faded so there
are no more 3" disks being made.
We must therefore face the fact
that a Plus 3 version of OUTLET
is living on borrowed time as,
although we may be able to re-
order in a few months time, it
is inevitable that this new
source of disks will also event-
ually, dry up.

Regulars will know there are
some 3.5" drives available for
the Plus 3 for which we are
unable to produce OUTLET, and
they will also know that we reg-
ularly plug the Plus D interface
(for which there is an OUTLET
version) and which can be bought
for the Plus 3.

We still have some leaflets on
this system and will be glad to
send one to anyone interested.
As we have said before, we have
no benefit from the distributor
in lauding this system but make
no apology for stating that, in
our opinion, this system is far
superior to the Plus 3 disk sys-
tem. The suppliers are:


     Datel Electronics Ltd
           Govan Road
    Fenton Industrial Estate
             FENTON
         Stoke-On-Trent
            ST4 2RS


    Telephone: 01782-744707


Datel have confirmed that they
have stocks - it costs `59.99
for an interface and `129.99 for
an interface with a disk drive.
(You need to identify which type
of Spectrum you have - +2, +2A,
+3, etc).


The cost of our new 3" disks
makes our `2.50 back issues look
very attractive and, depending
on the quality (and therefore
the wastage), of the disks we
may have to increase this price.


So, if you intend to stay with
the 3" disks, check your back
issues of OUTLET and get your
order in now!


      POISON IN THE WELL

Many of you will have read about
the arrest and conviction of
Chris Pile for criminal damage
caused by his computer viruses.

Chris was very active in the
Spectrum world some years ago
and produced some very useful
software - in fact the HIFORM
program which we use each month
to format the OUTLET disks to
203K (see above and Issue No.35)
was written by him.

The Spectrum is immune from vir-
uses but not the PC and the
world at large suffers greatly
from the pathetic people prod-
ucing these programs.


It is a sad business when a man
with such obvious talent feels
he has to turn his hand to writ-
ing and letting loose computer
viruses.


It is possible to understand (if
not always justify) when hate is
directed against an individual
or group, but where is the sense
in blindly unleashing a product
which cannot possibly be target-
ted against anyone but the world
in general?  It is even possible
to envisage a scenario where the
destruction could have a detri-
mental effect upon the author
(even ignoring the possibility
of being caught and punished).



In the unlikely event that an
author of virus programs should
read these words, perhaps they
would care to write in (anonim-
ously,no doubt)and give reasons
for producing and releasing such
uncontrollable devastation!


May we remind readers, we cannot
answer computer, software, hard-
ware or system queries etc.,
personally by mail.  All of such
queries are answered through the
OUTLETTERS section in OUTLET. We
are sorry to keep harping on
about this but it really needs
to be a permanent reminder!Share
your problems with others! That
way, everyone benefits!



Finally, remember, we still need
your support - and contributions
of articles and programs, espec-
ially utility programs, are now
needed more than ever.  Even a
short routine can be like gold
dust to another user! Send 'em
in!

                    Ron & Brian





      OUTLET is produced by
          Chris Oliver
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
      34 Saltersgate Drive
   Birstall, Leicester LE4 3FF
.

## Editorial (late)

J A N U A R Y,  1 9 9 6

There is a useful little program to repair certain types of BASIC corruption in this issue. We've not seen such a thing before yet already a more advanced fixer is on its way so watch out for that in a future issue!

Regular readers will remember that early in 1994 there was a severe shortage of 3" disks for the Plus 3 version of OUTLET. After a lot of chasing around we finally tracked down a couple of sources of "re-cycled" disks of unsold commercial software and this has carried us through the last 12 months.

These stocks have now come to an end and, after several telephone calls, we were looking at the unthinkable task of announcing the forthcoming end of the Plus 3 version of OUTLET in this very editorial! However, at the elev- enth hour, an advert torn from a magazine many months ago flutt- ered from a file and provided a reprieve.

A telephone call confirmed that stocks were available and our flexible friend took a thrashing as we decided to order 6 months stock.

As these words are being written the stock has only just been delivered so we do not yet know what quality these disks are but, hopefully, they will be at least as good as our dwindling present stocks.  These tend to have a 10% failure rate at the format stage with the odd disk being returned from readers after despatch.Part of the prob- lem here is the fact that we need to format them to 203K each side in order to cram on all the OUTLET goodies in every issue.

The original hope that Amstrad's factory in Italy would take up production has faded so there are no more 3" disks being made. We must therefore face the fact that a Plus 3 version of OUTLET is living on borrowed time as, although we may be able to re- order in a few months time, it is inevitable that this new source of disks will also event- ually, dry up.

Regulars will know there are some 3.5" drives available for the Plus 3 for which we are unable to produce OUTLET, and they will also know that we reg- ularly plug the Plus D interface (for which there is an OUTLET version) and which can be bought for the Plus 3.

We still have some leaflets on this system and will be glad to send one to anyone interested. As we have said before, we have no benefit from the distributor in lauding this system but make no apology for stating that, in our opinion, this system is far superior to the Plus 3 disk sys- tem. The suppliers are:

Datel Electronics Ltd Govan Road Fenton Industrial Estate FENTON Stoke-On-Trent ST4 2RS

Telephone: 01782-744707

Datel have confirmed that they have stocks - it costs `59.99 for an interface and `129.99 for an interface with a disk drive. (You need to identify which type of Spectrum you have - +2, +2A, +3, etc).

The cost of our new 3" disks makes our `2.50 back issues look very attractive and, depending on the quality (and therefore the wastage), of the disks we may have to increase this price.

So, if you intend to stay with the 3" disks, check your back issues of OUTLET and get your order in now!

POISON IN THE WELL

Many of you will have read about the arrest and conviction of Chris Pile for criminal damage caused by his computer viruses.

Chris was very active in the Spectrum world some years ago and produced some very useful software - in fact the HIFORM program which we use each month to format the OUTLET disks to 203K (see above and Issue No.35) was written by him.

The Spectrum is immune from vir- uses but not the PC and the world at large suffers greatly from the pathetic people prod- ucing these programs.

It is a sad business when a man with such obvious talent feels he has to turn his hand to writ- ing and letting loose computer viruses.

It is possible to understand (if not always justify) when hate is directed against an individual or group, but where is the sense in blindly unleashing a product which cannot possibly be target- ted against anyone but the world in general?  It is even possible to envisage a scenario where the destruction could have a detri- mental effect upon the author (even ignoring the possibility of being caught and punished).

In the unlikely event that an author of virus programs should read these words, perhaps they would care to write in (anonim- ously,no doubt)and give reasons for producing and releasing such uncontrollable devastation!

May we remind readers, we cannot answer computer, software, hard- ware or system queries etc., personally by mail.  All of such queries are answered through the OUTLETTERS section in OUTLET. We are sorry to keep harping on about this but it really needs to be a permanent reminder!Share your problems with others! That way, everyone benefits!

Finally, remember, we still need your support - and contributions of articles and programs, espec- ially utility programs, are now needed more than ever.  Even a short routine can be like gold dust to another user! Send 'em in!

Ron & Brian

body_ru:
## Editorial (late)

Я Н В А Р Ь, 1 9 9 6

В этом номере есть полезная небольшая программка для исправления определенных видов повреждений в BASIC. Раньше мы такого не встречали, но более продвинутый инструмент для ремонта уже на подходе, так что ждите его в одном из следующих выпусков!

Постоянные читатели помнят, что в начале 1994 года возникла острая нехватка 3" дискет для Plus 3 версии журнала OUTLET. После долгих поисков мы в конце концов вышли на пару источников «переработанных» дисков с нераспроданным коммерческим софтом, и это выручало нас последние 12 месяцев.

Эти запасы подошли к концу, и после череды телефонных звонков нам уже грозила немыслимая задача — объявить о грядущем закрытии версии OUTLET для Plus 3 прямо в этой колонке редактора! Однако в самый последний момент из папки с бумагами выпорхнуло рекламное объявление, вырезанное из журнала много месяцев назад, и подарило нам отсрочку.

Телефонный звонок подтвердил наличие дискет на складе, и нашей кредитке пришлось несладко: мы решили закупить запас на 6 месяцев вперед.

Когда пишутся эти строки, партию только-только доставили, поэтому мы пока не знаем, какого качества эти диски. Но, надеемся, они окажутся хотя бы не хуже наших тающих запасов. У тех процент брака на этапе форматирования доходил до 10%, плюс отдельные дискеты возвращались от читателей уже после рассылки. Отчасти проблема кроется в том, что нам приходится форматировать их на 203K на сторону, чтобы вместить все богатства каждого номера OUTLET.

Первоначальная надежда на то, что завод Amstrad в Италии возобновит производство, угасла — трехдюймовые диски больше не выпускаются. Поэтому нам приходится смотреть правде в глаза: версия OUTLET для Plus 3 доживает свой век. И хотя через несколько месяцев мы, возможно, сможем заказать еще партию, неизбежно наступит день, когда иссякнет и этот новый источник.

Постоянные читатели знают, что для Plus 3 существуют дисководы 3.5", под которые мы выпускать OUTLET не можем. А также знают, что мы регулярно рекламируем интерфейс Plus D (для которого версия OUTLET есть), подходящий и к Plus 3.

У нас все еще остались рекламные листовки этой системы, и мы с радостью вышлем их всем желающим. Как мы уже говорили, никакой выгоды от дистрибьютора за восхваление этой системы мы не получаем, однако без всяких колебаний утверждаем: по нашему мнению, она намного превосходит дисковую систему Plus 3. Поставщик:

```text
     Datel Electronics Ltd
           Govan Road
    Fenton Industrial Estate
             FENTON
         Stoke-On-Trent
            ST4 2RS

    Telephone: 01782-744707
```

Datel подтвердили наличие товара — интерфейс стоит £59.99, а комплект из интерфейса с дисководом — £129.99. (Вам нужно указать модель вашего Spectrum — +2, +2A, +3 и т. д.).

Учитывая стоимость наших новых 3" дискет, старые номера по £2.50 выглядят очень привлекательно. В зависимости от качества (и, соответственно, процента отбраковки) новых дисков нам, возможно, придется поднять эту цену.

Так что, если планируете оставаться на трехдюймовых дискетах, проверьте свою коллекцию прошлых номеров OUTLET и заказывайте прямо сейчас!

### POISON IN THE WELL

Многие из вас наверняка читали об аресте и осуждении Chris Pile за нанесение материального ущерба путем создания компьютерных вирусов.

Несколько лет назад Chris очень активно участвовал в жизни спектрумовского сообщества и написал немало полезных программ — собственно, утилита HIFORM, с помощью которой мы каждый месяц форматируем диски OUTLET на 203K (см. выше и выпуск №35), написана именно им.

Spectrum не подвержен вирусам, чего не скажешь о PC, и весь мир сильно страдает из-за жалких людишек, создающих подобные программы.

Печально, когда человек столь очевидного таланта считает нужным приложить руку к написанию и выпуску в свет компьютерных вирусов.

Можно понять (хотя и не всегда оправдать), когда ненависть направлена против конкретного человека или группы лиц. Но какой смысл слепо сеять продукт, который заведомо бьет без разбора по всему миру в целом? Вполне можно представить сценарий, при котором разрушения нанесут ущерб и самому автору (даже не считая вероятности быть пойманным и наказанным).

Если случится маловероятное, и автор вирусных программ прочтет эти строки — быть может, он соизволит написать нам (анонимно, разумеется) и объяснить причины создания и распространения столь неконтролируемого бедствия!

Напоминаем читателям: мы не можем отвечать на технические вопросы о компьютерах, софте, железе и системах лично по почте. Все подобные вопросы разбираются через раздел OUTLETTERS в OUTLET. Простите, что твердим об этом снова и снова, но напоминание действительно необходимо! Делитесь своими проблемами с остальными — от этого выигрывают все!

И напоследок: помните, что нам по-прежнему нужна ваша поддержка. Статьи и программы — особенно утилиты — сейчас нужны как никогда. Даже короткая подпрограмма может оказаться на вес золота для другого пользователя! Присылайте!

*Ron & Brian*

```text
          Chris Oliver
       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
      34 Saltersgate Drive
   Birstall, Leicester LE4 3FF
```
